boundaries.name: nullifier-insertion-and-freshness
boundaries.obligation: Derive the actual IndexedInsertionProof target relation, authenticated ordered-set invariant and no-reuse property. A callback return or changed root alone is not freshness.

boundaries.name: asset-merkle-binding
boundaries.obligation: Verify leaf hashing, low-endian path index decomposition, sibling-height/field bounds, hash compression and real old asset-tree ownership; source same-path wiring does not itself establish authenticated balances or authorization of the incoming amount.

boundaries.name: native-and-target-u256
boundaries.obligation: Native addition is an explicit normal-return/panic dependency. The target sum is derived from imported per-limb integer AddGates, whose field/gate lowering is still unproved. Full-width no-wrap also requires checked result limbs.

boundaries.name: runtime-refinement-and-caller-authorization
boundaries.obligation: Compiler/serde/debug/error formatting, dependency panics, witness-write failures and emitted target equivalence remain open. Deposit/transfer legitimacy, L1 finality and privacy-state authorization are caller obligations.
